  • Borders: Iraq closed the Sheeb/Al‑Shib crossing and most checkpoints with Iran “until further notice” to check security (Reuters/TASS).

  • Domestic/security: IDF deployed over 850 military polling stations from Mount Hermon to Eilat. IDF raid reported in Deir Jarir to prevent a provocation. Public safety advisory issued about interception debris — do not touch; call police.
  • Humanitarian: Gaza children face worsening food shortages as prices rise and aid is cut (Al Jazeera).
  • Other actions: Malaysia banned civil servants from using Waze citing links to Israel. Reuters: Israel accepted as a Pacific Islands Forum partner.
  • Local incidents: reports of rail equipment vandalized citing “ties to the IDF.” Media outlets repeatedly reported increased Israeli air activity near Iraq/Syria.
  • Bottom line: Supported by multiple reports of air rehearsals, border closures and allied deployments — regional military posture is escalating.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF maintained voting access with 850+ polling stations; financial aid reported for 20,000 affected workers; Israel accepted as Pacific Islands Forum partner.
